meta.note: Monthly Operating Plan (MOP) targets for Control Tower — manually maintained by Manas, same pattern as targets.json. Each entry is a FULL-MONTH target; the dashboard linearly pro-rates it to 'today' for MTD comparison (target * cutoff_day / days_in_month) — this file does NOT store day-level pacing. Referral channel only. Omit a cluster under 'by_cluster' to fall back to 'global' for that cluster (global is used as-is, not divided among unlisted clusters).
